name: Rogue
description: Rogues rely on cunning, precision, and a broad collection of practiced skills. They exploit openings with Sneak Attack, move through danger with remarkable agility, and solve problems that brute force cannot.
weapon_proficiencies: Martial Weapons with the Finesse or Light property

subclasses.name: Arcane Trickster
subclasses.description: Enhance stealth, misdirection, and legerdemain with carefully chosen Wizard magic.

grants.name: Spellcasting
grants.description: Cast prepared Wizard spells using Intelligence and an Arcane Focus. You know Mage Hand and two other Wizard cantrips, and you prepare three level 1 Wizard spells. The cantrip, prepared-spell, and spell-slot progressions are represented at every Rogue level; complete spell selection is deferred to the shared spell-system pass.

grants.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
grants.description: When you cast Mage Hand, the hand is invisible. You can control it as a Bonus Action and use it to stow or retrieve an object carried by another creature, manipulate a container, or use Thieves' Tools at range. You can perform these tasks unnoticed by winning a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by a creature's Wisdom (Perception) check.

grants.name: Magical Ambush
grants.description: If you have the Invisible condition when you cast a spell on a creature, it has Disadvantage on every saving throw it makes against that spell on the same turn.

grants.name: Versatile Trickster
grants.description: When you use the Trip option of Cunning Strike, you can also target a second creature within 5 feet of your Mage Hand.

grants.name: Spell Thief
grants.description: Immediately after a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area, use your Reaction to force it to make a save using its spellcasting ability against your spell save DC. On a failure, the spell has no effect on you. If it is level 1 or higher and of a level you can cast, you also prepare it for 8 hours and the creature can't cast it during that time. Once used, this feature can't be used again until a Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Assassin
subclasses.description: Use disguise, poison, and decisive first strikes to eliminate foes before they can recover.

grants.name: Assassin's Tools
grants.description: You gain proficiency with the Disguise Kit and Poisoner's Kit.

grants.name: Assassinate
grants.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls. During the first round of each combat, you have Advantage on attacks against creatures that haven't taken a turn. When your Sneak Attack hits during that round, the target also takes damage of the weapon's type equal to your Rogue level.

grants.name: Infiltration Expertise
grants.description: While wearing a disguise made with your Disguise Kit, you have Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made while pretending to be someone else. After studying a person's speech, handwriting, or both for at least 1 hour, you can mimic what you studied unerringly.

grants.name: Envenom Weapons
grants.description: Whenever a target fails its save against your Cunning Strike's Poison option, it also takes 2d6 Poison damage. This damage ignores resistance to Poison damage.

grants.name: Death Strike
grants.description: When your Sneak Attack hits during the first round of combat, the target makes a Constitution save against your Cunning Strike save DC. On a failure, the attack's damage is doubled against that target.

subclasses.name: Soulknife
subclasses.description: Awaken psionic talent that sharpens your skills, links minds, and manifests blades of psychic energy.

grants.name: Psionic Power
grants.description: You have four d6 Psionic Energy Dice, gaining six d8s at Rogue level 5, eight d8s at level 9, eight d10s at level 11, ten d10s at level 13, and twelve d12s at level 17. Psi-Bolstered Knack can add a die to a failed proficient skill or tool check, expending it only if the check succeeds. As a Magic action, Psychic Whispers links you telepathically for a number of hours equal to a die roll with up to your Proficiency Bonus of creatures you can see; linked creatures can communicate while within 1 mile of one another and needn't share a language. The first link after a Long Rest doesn't expend the rolled die. A Short Rest restores one die and a Long Rest restores all.

grants.name: Psychic Blades
grants.description: When you take the Attack action or make an Opportunity Attack, you can manifest a free-hand Psychic Blade for that attack. It is a simple melee weapon with Finesse, Thrown (60/120), and Vex; it deals 1d6 Psychic damage and vanishes after the attack. After attacking with it on your turn, you can make a Bonus Action attack with a second blade that deals 1d4 Psychic damage.

grants.name: Soul Blades
grants.description: Homing Strikes lets you roll a Psionic Energy Die and add it to a missed Psychic Blade attack, expending the die only if the attack then hits. Psychic Teleportation lets you use a Bonus Action to expend and roll a die, throw a Psychic Blade to an unoccupied space you can see, and teleport to it if it is within a number of feet equal to 10 times the roll.

grants.name: Psychic Veil
grants.description: As a Magic action, become Invisible for 1 hour or until you dismiss the effect, deal damage, or force a creature to make a saving throw. Use this once per Long Rest without expending a Psionic Energy Die; additional uses expend one die.

grants.name: Rend Mind
grants.description: When a Psychic Blade deals Sneak Attack damage, force the target to make a Wisdom save against your Cunning Strike save DC. On a failure, it is Stunned for 1 minute and repeats the save at the end of each turn. Use this once per Long Rest without expending Psionic Energy Dice; additional uses expend three dice.

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.description: Master infiltration, mobility, and the opportunistic use of objects and magic items.

grants.name: Fast Hands
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock, disarm a trap with Thieves' Tools, or pick a pocket; take the Utilize action; or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires that action.

grants.name: Second-Story Work
grants.description: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and you can determine your jump distance using Dexterity instead of Strength.

grants.name: Supreme Sneak
grants.description: You gain the Stealth Attack Cunning Strike option (cost 1d6). If you have the Invisible condition from the Hide action, the attack doesn't end that condition if you finish the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover.

grants.name: Use Magic Device
grants.description: You can attune to four magic items at once. When a magic item property spends charges, roll 1d6; on a 6, no charge is spent. You can use any Spell Scroll with Intelligence: cantrips and level 1 spells work automatically, while higher-level spells require a successful Intelligence (Arcana) check with DC 10 plus the spell's level.

grants.name: Thief's Reflexes
grants.description: During the first round of combat, take a second turn at your Initiative count minus 10.

grants.name: Rogue Skill Proficiencies
grants.description: Choose four skills from the Rogue skill list.

grants.name: Expertise
grants.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for checks using either skill.

grants.name: Sneak Attack
grants.description: Once per turn, deal the Sneak Attack damage shown for your Rogue level when you hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon and have Advantage. You don't need Advantage if a non-Incapacitated ally is within 5 feet of the target and you don't have Disadvantage.

grants.name: Thieves' Cant
grants.description: You know Thieves' Cant and learn one other language of your choice.

grants.name: Thieves' Cant Language
grants.description: Choose the additional language you learned alongside Thieves' Cant.

grants.name: Weapon Mastery
grants.description: Choose two weapons with which you have proficiency. You can use their mastery properties and change your choices after a Long Rest.
proficiency: Martial Weapons with the Finesse or Light property

grants.name: Cunning Action
grants.description: On your turn, take Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a Bonus Action.

grants.name: Rogue Subclass
grants.description: Choose a Rogue subclass, gaining its features now and again at Rogue levels 9, 13, and 17.

grants.name: Steady Aim
grants.description: If you haven't moved during the current turn, use a Bonus Action to gain Advantage on your next attack roll this turn. Your Speed becomes 0 until the turn ends.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Cunning Strike
grants.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, forgo damage dice to add one effect (save DC 8 + Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus): Poison costs 1d6 and can Poison the target for 1 minute if you carry a Poisoner's Kit; Trip costs 1d6 and can knock a Large or smaller target Prone; Withdraw costs 1d6 and lets you move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

grants.name: Uncanny Dodge
grants.description: When an attacker you can see hits you with an attack roll, use your Reaction to halve the attack's damage against you, rounded down.

grants.name: Expertise
grants.description: Choose two more skill proficiencies in which you don't already have Expertise.

grants.name: Evasion
grants.description: When an effect allows a Dexterity save for half damage, take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure. You can't use this while Incapacitated.

grants.name: Reliable Talent
grants.description: When an ability check uses one of your skill or tool proficiencies, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Rogue Subclass Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen Rogue subclass.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Improved Cunning Strike
grants.description: Apply up to two Cunning Strike effects to one Sneak Attack, paying the die cost for each effect.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Rogue Subclass Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen Rogue subclass.

grants.name: Devious Strikes
grants.description: Add three Cunning Strike options: Daze costs 2d6 and limits a failed Constitution-save target to only moving, taking an action, or taking a Bonus Action on its next turn; Knock Out costs 6d6 and can make a target Unconscious for up to 1 minute; Obscure costs 3d6 and can Blind a target until the end of its next turn.

grants.name: Slippery Mind
grants.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Rogue Subclass Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen Rogue subclass.

grants.name: Elusive
grants.description: No attack roll can have Advantage against you unless you are Incapacitated.

grants.name: Epic Boon
grants.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify. Boon of the Night Spirit is recommended.

grants.name: Stroke of Luck
grants.description: When you fail a D20 Test, turn the roll into a 20. Once used, this feature can't be used again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.
